title: The Maple Street Club
instructions: 阅读短文，完成8道题。所有题目和选项均为英文。注意：we/they 后用 are；my/your/his/her 后接名词；have 用于 I/you/we/they，has 用于 he/she。答案必须来自原文。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方考试。
passage:
A. This is the Maple Street Club. We are a small club. We meet on Fridays. My name is Anna. I am the club leader. Your name is on the list. His name is Ben. Her name is Cara. They are new members.

B. Ben and Cara are students. They have two books. We have a big table. I have a red bag. You have a blue pen. Ben has a small dog. Cara has a white cat. The dog and the cat are friends.

C. We are happy. They are happy, too. The club is fun.

grammar.title: we / they + are；my / your / his / her；have / has
grammar.explanation: 新规则：we（我们）和 they（他们/她们/它们）后面用 are。例如：We are happy. They are happy. 否定：We are not happy. They are not happy. 一般疑问：Are they happy? 回答：Yes, they are. / No, they are not. 形容词性物主代词：my（我的）、your（你的/你们的）、his（他的）、her（她的），后面必须接名词。例如：my bag, your pen, his dog, her cat。动词 have 表示“有”：I / you / we / they 用 have；he / she 用 has。例如：We have a table. Ben has a dog. 复习：I am, you are, he/she is（已学）。
grammar.example: We are happy. They are happy, too.

questions.explanation: Ben 是第三人称单数，用 has。
后面有名词 pen，用形容词性物主代词 your。
they 的肯定回答用 they are。
we 的否定用 are not。
